MappingFields.Name: Username
MappingFields.Description: Username of the person in Infolearn. Mandatory

MappingFields.Name: Medewerker
MappingFields.Description: Unique identifier of the person (correlation field). Mandatory

MappingFields.Name: Geboortedatum
MappingFields.Description: Birth date of the person. The script writes it in the format dd/MM/yyyy

MappingFields.Name: Opdrachtgevernaam
MappingFields.Description: External ID of the organization of the contract. The script sets this per contract (one row per contract in conditions); this mapping only defines the column

MappingFields.Name: Opdrachtgever
MappingFields.Description: Name of the organization of the contract. The script sets this per contract; this mapping only defines the column

MappingFields.Name: OE_code
MappingFields.Description: Department code of the contract. The script sets this per contract; this mapping only defines the column

MappingFields.Name: OE
MappingFields.Description: Department name of the contract. The script sets this per contract; this mapping only defines the column

MappingFields.Name: Functie_code
MappingFields.Description: Job title code of the contract. The script sets this per contract; this mapping only defines the column

MappingFields.Name: Functie
MappingFields.Description: Job title name of the contract. The script sets this per contract; this mapping only defines the column

MappingFields.Name: NaamSamengesteld
MappingFields.Description: Composed name of the person (custom person field)

MappingFields.Name: VoorvoegselSamengesteld
MappingFields.Description: Composed name prefix of the person (custom person field)

MappingFields.Name: Email_werk
MappingFields.Description: Business email address of the person
